title: Parmarth Niketan Ashram Rishikesh - Yoga, Ganga Aarti & Spiritual Retreat
content:
Parmarth Niketan Ashram - Rishikesh,

Parmarth Niketan Ashram is the largest and one of the most respected spiritual centers in Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, situated on the holy banks of the Ganga River near Ram Jhula. Established in 1942 by Swami Shukdevanand Ji Maharaj, it is now led by HH Pujya Swami Chidanand Saraswatiji Maharaj.

The ashram is world-renowned for its yoga, meditation, Ayurveda, and spiritual teachings. Every year, thousands of seekers and travelers from across the globe come here to learn yoga, experience inner peace, and connect with Indian spiritual traditions.

The highlight of Parmarth Niketan is the evening Ganga Aarti, held daily on the riverbank. Unlike the crowded ghats, this Aarti feels peaceful and deeply devotional, with chants, music, and the glow of oil lamps creating a truly divine atmosphere.

Parmarth Niketan also hosts the International Yoga Festival every March, attracting yoga enthusiasts, teachers, and spiritual leaders from around the world. With over 1,000 rooms, lush gardens, and serene surroundings, it offers the perfect environment for self-discovery and spiritual growth.

Best Time to Visit Parmarth Niketan Ashram Rishikesh:

  • Peak Season (October - March): Comfortable weather with average temperatures 10°C - 25°C. Best time for yoga sessions, attending the International Yoga Festival, and spiritual activities.
  • Moderate Season (April - June): Warm with temperatures 20°C - 35°C. Ideal for meditation and yoga retreats, though afternoons can be hot.
  • Low Season (July - September): Monsoon season with average temperatures 18°C - 30°C. The ashram remains open, but outdoor activities may be limited. The greenery and riverbanks are exceptionally scenic.

Things to Do at Parmarth Niketan Ashram:

  • Attend the peaceful evening Ganga Aarti.
  • Join yoga and meditation sessions with trained instructors.
  • Participate in Ayurveda and healing therapies.
  • Explore the statue of Lord Shiva in the Ganga.
  • Stay at the ashram for a spiritual retreat.
  • Join the International Yoga Festival in March.

How to Reach Parmarth Niketan Ashram:

  • By Road: Located near Ram Jhula, easily accessible by auto, taxi, or on foot from Rishikesh center.
  • By Train: Rishikesh railway station is around 5 km away.
  • By Air: Jolly Grant Airport, Dehradun (20 km away).

Best Places to Visit Near Parmarth Niketan Ashram (within 50 km):

1- Ram Jhula (500 m): Iconic suspension bridge across the Ganga.

2- Laxman Jhula (2 km): Famous hanging bridge with temples & cafes.

3- Triveni Ghat (2.5 km): Known for holy dips and Ganga Aarti.

4- Beatles Ashram (3 km): Historic site visited by The Beatles.

5- Neelkanth Mahadev Temple (32 km): Sacred Shiva temple in the forest.

6- Rajaji National Park (18 km – Chilla Gate): For safaris & wildlife spotting.

7- Kunjapuri Temple (25 km): Offers stunning sunrise views.

8- Har Ki Pauri, Haridwar (28 km): World-famous ghat for Ganga Aarti.

9- Mansa Devi Temple, Haridwar (30 km): Shakti Peeth with ropeway access.

10- Chandi Devi Temple, Haridwar (32 km): Hilltop temple offering panoramic views.
excerpt: Parmarth Niketan Ashram Rishikesh is the largest spiritual retreat on the banks of the Ganga, offering yoga, meditation, Ayurveda, and soulful Ganga Aarti. With serene surroundings, thousands of rooms, and the world-famous International Yoga Festival, it is a must-visit for seekers of peace, spirituality, and wellness.
